answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Each submission hangs on the spiral of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the zephyr is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
